chronicle.worldbetween.neris.arrival: Fugitives stepped out of a Nether portal: former slaves of the Hellsmiths. They made camp %s at (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_farm: The first field was ploughed in %s. The former slaves eat bread grown by their own hands.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_lumbe: The axes of the first lumber camp ring out in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_quarr: The first quarry was opened in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mine: The first mine was dug in %s. The Neris are underground again, but by their own will.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_smelt: The first smelter was lit in %s. The fire that once burned them now serves them.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_forge: The first blade was forged in %s. The Hellsmiths taught them well.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_barra: The first barracks stand in %s. The Kingdom of Neris is raising an army.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.famine: Famine in %s. People are dying of hunger.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.tier_1: The camp of %s has grown into a settlement.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.tier_2: %s has been walled and is now a fort.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_1: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Bronze Age.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_2: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Iron Age. Their guards now wear iron.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_3: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Steel Age. Their army is a power everyone must reckon with.

chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_pier: A pier was built at %s. The Neris go out on the water to fish.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mill: The sails of the first mill turn over %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_baker: A bakery smokes in %s. The smell of bread carries far.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_kitch: A common kitchen opened in %s. Soldiers and workers eat hot meals.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_sawmi: The saws of the first sawmill sing in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mason: The first stonemasons work in %s. The kingdom learns to build in stone.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_charc: A charcoal kiln smokes by %s. The smelters need heat.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_tanne: A tannery works in %s, turning hides into leather for armour.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_weave: Looms clatter in %s. Uniforms are sewn for the soldiers of Neris.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_libra: A library opened in %s. The Neris write down their history, never to lose it again.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_wareh: The first warehouse was built in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_marke: A market opened on the square of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_watch: The first watchtower rises over %s, flying the kingdom's banner.

book.worldbetween.chronicle.title: Chronicle of %s
book.worldbetween.chronicle.intro:
A settlement of %s.
Founded on day %s.

Here is written all that has befallen it.

noble.worldbetween.name: %s %s
chronicle.worldbetween.court.first_king: %s, who led the fugitives out, became the first king of Neris. His throne stands in the camp of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.baron_rise: %s rose to become a baron of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.baron_fall: %s lost the barony: the treasury of %s can no longer keep him.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.baron_death: Baron %s died of old age in %s.

King %s died of illness in %s. The council of barons meets tomorrow.
King %s was murdered by conspirators in %s. The council of barons meets tomorrow.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.plot_succes: Baron %s plotted against King %s. The threads of the plot lead to %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.plot_failed: The plot of Baron %s against King %s was uncovered. The traitor was executed, and his people in %s fell silent.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.elected: The council of barons elected %s of %s king: %s votes of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.acclaimed: The last of the barons, %s of %s, was proclaimed king.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.regency: The kingdom has neither king nor barons. A council of elders rules.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.drunk: Baron %s feasted beyond measure again. Much went missing from the treasury and granaries of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.deserters: The treasury is empty: %s soldiers left the service unpaid.
command.worldbetween.court.no_king: The throne is empty. The council of barons meets on day %s.
speech.worldbetween.citizen.0: Freedom smells of bread, stranger. We waited long for that smell.
speech.worldbetween.citizen.1: Mind the road: the ore carts do not turn aside.
speech.worldbetween.citizen.2: My grandfathers forged chains for blazes. I forge horseshoes. It is better.
speech.worldbetween.worker.0: Plenty of work, too few hands. As ever.
speech.worldbetween.worker.1: Hands off the tools. They belong to the kingdom.
speech.worldbetween.worker.2: The shift ends at sundown. We can talk then.
speech.worldbetween.guard.0: Pass, but remember: the law here is the law of Neris.
speech.worldbetween.guard.2: We hang thieves on the gates. A joke. Half of one.
speech.worldbetween.guard.mine: These are the kingdom's depths. Leave while there is time.
speech.worldbetween.criminal: You are a criminal of the kingdom. Defend yourself!
speech.worldbetween.seeker.site: I am looking for the place a new town will stand. Do not get in my way.
speech.worldbetween.seeker.mine: There is iron under these hills. I can smell it.
speech.worldbetween.seeker.scout: Ah, there you are. I wanted a look at you.
speech.worldbetween.seeker.return: I am going home with news. Make way!
speech.worldbetween.seeker.idle: I am a Seeker of Neris. We see everything under the sky.
speech.worldbetween.king: I am %s, king of Neris. Speak quickly: the kingdom has much to do.
speech.worldbetween.baron.wealth: I am %s. If you came to trade, speak. If you came to beg, leave.
speech.worldbetween.baron.army: I am %s. The kingdom needs swords, not talk.
speech.worldbetween.baron.science: I am %s. Do you know anything we do not?
speech.worldbetween.baron.war: I am %s. These lands will need warriors soon. Are you one?
speech.worldbetween.baron.glory: I am %s. Seen our walls? In a hundred years they will be seen from the mountains.
speech.worldbetween.baron.expansion: I am %s. Beyond that hill our next town will stand.
speech.worldbetween.baron.vengeance: I am %s. One day we will go back to the Nether, and the Hellsmiths will answer for everything.
speech.worldbetween.baron.order: I am %s. Keep the law and we will get along.
chronicle.worldbetween.seeker.recruited: A new Seeker was trained in the barracks of %2$s: %1$s.
chronicle.worldbetween.seeker.site: Seeker %s found a place for a new town at (%s, %s) and raised a cairn with the banner there.
chronicle.worldbetween.seeker.mine: Seeker %s found rich ore near %s and drove in a survey stake.
chronicle.worldbetween.seeker.scout: Seeker %s tracked down a stranger named %s at (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.seeker.killed_by: Seeker %s was killed at (%s, %s) by a stranger named %s. The kingdom will not forget.
chronicle.worldbetween.court.king_slain: King %s was slain in %s by %s. The council of barons meets tomorrow.
message.worldbetween.arrival.far: %s, some %s blocks from here, the sky flares crimson for a moment and distant thunder rolls. Something has broken through into this world.
message.worldbetween.arrival.near: The air tears open in crimson fire. One by one, people with bronze skin and black eyes step out of the portal.
message.worldbetween.arrival.collapse: Behind them the portal cracks and goes dark. There is no way back.
speech.worldbetween.arrival.0: Air... real air. Not smoke, not brimstone.
speech.worldbetween.arrival.1: The sky. I thought it was an old men's tale.
speech.worldbetween.arrival.2: We are free. Remember this day, stranger: today a kingdom was born.
speech.worldbetween.arrival.3: Out of the way. We have much to do.
book.worldbetween.exodus.0:
EXODUS

We forged for the Forge-masters of Hell. We worked their bellows, we poured fire into their efreets, and our chains were of the same steel as their blades.
book.worldbetween.exodus.1: When the Forge-masters' strength began to fail, we struck off our chains. We walked through the ash for forty days, and all the beasts of Hell came after us.
book.worldbetween.exodus.2: We lit the last portal with our own hands. It held exactly long enough for all of us to pass. Then it cracked, as our chains had cracked.
book.worldbetween.exodus.3:
Here we will build a kingdom. And when it is strong, we will go back — not as slaves, but as an army.

— Neris

speech.worldbetween.guard.hall: What are you doing in here? Out of the hall!
speech.worldbetween.guard.throne: How dare you come before the king?! Out, or die!
speech.worldbetween.guard.door.baron: The baron does not receive just anyone. Earn the kingdom's trust (reputation %s needed).

speech.worldbetween.guard.door.king.last: Last warning. One more step towards the king and you die.

chronicle.worldbetween.neris.outlaw_hall: The stranger %s broke into the hall of %s and is now an outlaw.

chronicle.worldbetween.neris.outlaw_unwe: The stranger %s refused to leave %s and was declared a criminal.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.outlaw_curf: The stranger %s broke the curfew in %s and was declared a criminal.

speech.worldbetween.king.audience.wealth: The king receives you. Have you come with something profitable, %s? The kingdom values those who are useful.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.wealt: Have you come with something profitable, %s? The kingdom values those who are useful.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.army: The king receives you. I have heard of you, %s. The kingdom needs strong arms; remember that.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.army: I have heard of you, %s. The kingdom needs strong arms; remember that.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.scienc: The king receives you. Welcome, %s. Tell me what you have seen beyond our borders.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.scien: Welcome, %s. Tell me what you have seen beyond our borders.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.war: The king receives you. War is coming, %s. When it does, I want to know whose side you are on.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.war: War is coming, %s. When it does, I want to know whose side you are on.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.glory: The king receives you. Look at this hall, %s. In a hundred years they will sing of it.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.glory: Look at this hall, %s. In a hundred years they will sing of it.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.expans: The king receives you. Our seekers have seen you, %s. There is land enough for everyone — for now.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.expan: Our seekers have seen you, %s. There is land enough for everyone — for now.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.vengea: The king receives you. Have you seen Hell, %s? One day we will go back, and the Forge-masters will answer for everything.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.venge: Have you seen Hell, %s? One day we will go back, and the Forge-masters will answer for everything.
speech.worldbetween.king.audience.order: The king receives you. You have kept our law, %s. The kingdom remembers that.
speech.worldbetween.baron.audience.order: You have kept our law, %s. The kingdom remembers that.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.criminal: I do not trade with criminals. Go, before the guards see you.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.refuse: I don't want your iron. Earn a good name first.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.empty: Nothing to sell or buy today. Come back later.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.greet.hosti: Pay up front. And be quick.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.greet.stran: A stranger with iron? Fine, look at the goods. Prices are lower for friends.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.greet.known: Ah, you again. Take a look.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.greet.trust: A friend of the kingdom! A special price for you.
speech.worldbetween.merchant.greet.honou: For an honoured guest, the best our stores have.
message.worldbetween.trade.goodwill: %s are grateful: you brought what they were short of.
command.worldbetween.arrive.replay: The arrival scene waits again for a witness at the portal (%s, %s, %s).
message.worldbetween.outlaw: %s declare you a criminal. Their guards will attack on sight.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.quakes: Since morning the earth has shaken again and again. Deep under the mountains something has heard a sound unheard for millions of years: Hell has opened.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.arrival: The mountains split open in %s places at once. The Kaments have woken from the mourning sleep.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.awakening: Kaments walked out of the mountain near (%2$s, %3$s). Their hold is called %1$s, their Ancient is %4$s.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.sculptor: A new soul-sculptor has woken in %s: more soul was poured into it than into any other.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.carved: In %s a soul-sculptor gave a part of itself to the stone, and the stone opened its eyes. Its name is %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_quar: The first quarry was cut in %s. The mountain gives its stone, not its blood.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_grav: Gravel is being dug in %s: flint will come of it.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_knap: The first flint was sifted in %s. The key to all the Kaments' crafts is in their hands again.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_carv: In %s they dress stone again, as at the beginning of time.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_scul: A soul-sculptor's hall has been hewn in %s. A people that is never born can grow again.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_memo: A hall of memory has been hewn in %s. The Kaments remember everything; now they write it down too.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.first_heal: A hall of the vein-healers has opened in %s. Metal taken will go back into the mountain.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.tier_1: The bed of %s has become a hall. Soon they will dig deep below it.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.tier_3: %s has become a stronghold such as stood before life began.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.deep_tier_: The deep city of %s has grown into a deep hall.
%s under the mountain has become a chamber.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.succession: %s takes the seat of the Ancient in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.council: The council of Ancients met and resolved: from now on the people work for %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.deep_city: Under %s they went down the spiral stair into the dark and founded the deep city of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.tunnel_beg: From %s a deep tunnel of some %s blocks has been begun.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.tunnel_thr: The tunnel from %s is through the rock; at its end the city of %s was founded near (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.new_hold: Kaments of %s went to another peak and hewed the hold of %s near (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.era_1: The Kaments have left their mourning: the age of Waking has begun.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.era_2: The Kaments have entered the age of Renewal. Their sculptors make sculptors again.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.era_3: The Kaments have entered the age of Greatness, as before the first war.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.outlaw_met: The stranger %s would not give up metal on the land of %s. The Kaments will remember.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.outlaw_ore: The stranger %s bled the mountain at %s before their eyes. The Kaments judged them an enemy.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.slain: In %s the stranger %s broke a Kament. The Kaments remember every one.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.ancient_sl: The Ancient %s of %s fell by the hand of the stranger %s. The Kaments will never forget it.
The Ancient %s of %s crumbled to dust.
message.worldbetween.kament.demand: Give a Kament all your metal (use on a Kament) or leave their land. You have %s s.
message.worldbetween.kament.left: You have left their land. The Kaments watch you go.
message.worldbetween.kament.enemy: The Kaments judge you an enemy. Their guards will attack for as long as the mountain remembers, and it remembers everything.
message.worldbetween.kament.taken: The Kament took your metal: %s pieces
message.worldbetween.kament.bleed: You mined ore on Kament land. The mountain bleeds; they will feel it.
message.worldbetween.kament.bleed_seen: A Kament saw you bleed the mountain. It will not forget.
message.worldbetween.kament.quake: The ground trembles. Deep under the mountains something stirs, for the first time in ages.
message.worldbetween.kament.awaken_near: With a deafening crack the mountain splits. Stone walks out of the rock, and looks at you.
message.worldbetween.kament.awaken_far: %s, some %s blocks away, a mountain split with a roar. %s holds have woken in all. The Kaments are awake.
tooltip.worldbetween.metal: Metal: the Kaments will demand it
speech.worldbetween.kament.worker.0: Stone is patient. So am I.
speech.worldbetween.kament.worker.1: Do not disturb me. This block has waited a thousand years for me.
speech.worldbetween.kament.worker.2: You breathe so fast. How do you have time to think?
speech.worldbetween.kament.guard.0: Without metal you may pass. With it, no.
speech.worldbetween.kament.guard.1: I stood at these gates when there was neither grass nor beast.
speech.worldbetween.kament.sculptor.0: Everyone I hew takes a part of me away.
speech.worldbetween.kament.sculptor.1: See the crack? That is where the soul goes in.
speech.worldbetween.kament.sculptor.2: We were more than the stars. Now I count every one.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.0: We remember the world before life. We remember the war that made Hell.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.2: Hell is open. So it is time for us again.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.mindf: I am %s. I will remember you. I remember everyone.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.patie: I am %s. I have nowhere to hurry to; you, it seems, have.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.wrath: I am %s. The last one who shouted in this hall became gravel.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.griev: I am %s. We were so many. The ritual left only those who knew how to be silent.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.deep: I am %s. Deeper, always deeper. There is a silence there we remember.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.sculp: I am %s. I have given the stone more soul than you have.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.cold: I am %s. Your gifts weigh nothing.
speech.worldbetween.kament.ancient.curio: I am %s. Tell me, what is it like to live so briefly?
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.quarry: The mountain gives stone if you ask properly.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.gravel_p: Gravel is mountains that grew tired. Flint comes out of it.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.knappery: Flint. Sharper than any of your metal, and more honest.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.carvery: Every block must lie as if it grew here.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.sculptor: Quiet. It has not opened its eyes yet.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.memory: Everything is written here. Your name too, if you gave cause.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.healer: This vein was torn out. We will heal it. The metal goes back to the mountain.
speech.worldbetween.kament.work.ward: We wait. We know how to wait.
speech.worldbetween.kament.enemy: You are an enemy of the mountain. Go while you can still walk.
speech.worldbetween.kament.demand: Metal is the mountain's blood. Give me all you have taken out of it. All of it.
speech.worldbetween.kament.surrendered: The mountain takes back its blood. Go in peace.
speech.worldbetween.kament.gift: You gave without being asked. That will be remembered.
command.worldbetween.hold.none: The Kaments have not woken yet.
command.worldbetween.hold.carving: A sculptor is hewing a new Kament: %s more days.
command.worldbetween.council.header: The council of Ancients. Present resolve: %s
speech.worldbetween.kament.idle: I slept so long I forgot the sound of my own voice. Let me grow used to it.
chronicle.worldbetween.kament.sculptor_d: A soul-sculptor of %s went down the spiral stair to %s, so that stone may open its eyes there too.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.arrival: A blue and violet comet fell from the sky. Out of the capsule on the water came the Arki, exiles whose gods took the sky from them. Their colony is called %s, near (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.colony: A new comet fell into the sea near (%2$s, %3$s): the Arki colony of %1$s has grown there.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.sky_colony: A comet never reached the ground: high above (%2$s, %3$s) an island hangs in the air, and on it the Arki colony of %1$s.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.arrivals: The colony of %s gathered starlight enough and called %s more exiles out of the dark.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.help: A capsule went from %s to %s: %s. The colonies do not rule one another, but they do not abandon one another either.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.summon: The colony of %s calls a comet: somewhere in the world a new Arki colony will soon grow.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.first_garden: The first amethyst garden was grown in %s. The crystals grow as trees grow here.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.first_lens: A lens was raised in %s: now starlight is gathered every night.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.first_seawor: %s has taken its first gifts from the sea.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.first_observ: An observatory has opened in %s. The Arki read again the secrets they were exiled for.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.first_pad: A capsule pad has been laid out in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.tier_1: The capsule of %s has become a colony.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.era_1: The Arki have found refuge in this world.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.era_2: The Arki grow their star gardens: their knowledge grows again.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.era_3: The Arki are building a second sky, one that cannot be taken from them.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.slain: In %s the stranger %s put out one of the Arki.
message.worldbetween.arki.comet_near: %s, %s blocks away, a blue and violet comet is streaking across the sky!
message.worldbetween.arki.comet_far: %s, some %s blocks away, a blue and violet comet streaked across the sky and fell into the sea.
speech.worldbetween.arki.gatherer.0: The sea is kinder than the sky. The sky cast us out.
speech.worldbetween.arki.gatherer.1: Water remembers the stars: they are reflected in it.
speech.worldbetween.arki.gatherer.2: Are you an exile too? Your days are so short.
speech.worldbetween.arki.gardener.0: Amethyst grows slowly. We have learned to wait.
speech.worldbetween.arki.gardener.1: Every crystal is a small sky.
speech.worldbetween.arki.gardener.2: Do not touch the buds. They are listening.
speech.worldbetween.arki.astronomer.0: The gods hid their secrets in starlight. We read them at night.
speech.worldbetween.arki.astronomer.1: The moon is full tonight. The light pours like a river.
speech.worldbetween.arki.astronomer.2: We were cast out for longing after their secrets. We do not repent.
speech.worldbetween.arki.keeper.0: This capsule carried us through the wrath of the gods.
speech.worldbetween.arki.keeper.1: The colonies do not rule one another. But we remember one another.
speech.worldbetween.arki.keeper.2: Come closer. I want to look at you.
speech.worldbetween.arki.work.seaworks: The sea gives, if you do not take too much.
speech.worldbetween.arki.work.observator: Every star is a locked door. We are looking for the keys.
speech.worldbetween.arki.work.dwelling: This is our home. For now.
speech.worldbetween.arki.work.pad: From here the capsules leave for the other colonies.
command.worldbetween.comet.none: No comet is on its way.
command.worldbetween.colony.comets: Comets and capsules on their way: %s
command.worldbetween.colony.summary: — Arki: %s of %s, disc (%s, %s, %s); amethyst %s, sea goods %s, starlight %s, lore %s
item.worldbetween.chisel.tooltip: Stays in the grid after every cut
item.worldbetween.stone_amulet.tooltip: Works from the inventory; no more than three charms at once
item.worldbetween.stone_gear.tooltip: Stone remembers the mountain: mends while you stand on rock
charm.worldbetween.deep.effect.1: Night vision in the deep and the dark
charm.worldbetween.deep.effect.2: Night vision in the deep, and fire resistance
charm.worldbetween.ward.effect.1: Stone shell (Absorption I), returns once a minute
charm.worldbetween.ward.effect.2: Stone shell (Absorption II), returns once a minute
speech.worldbetween.kament.trade.metal: Take off the metal first. Stone does not deal with one who flaunts the mountain's blood.
speech.worldbetween.kament.trade.refuse: You are no friend of ours. Stone remembers.
speech.worldbetween.kament.trade.empty: We have nothing to give now. Stone grows slowly.
speech.worldbetween.kament.trade.greet: Stone for flint. Shards are our measure.
speech.worldbetween.kament.trade.charm_r: Charms of stone are for friends of the mountain. You are not one yet.
speech.worldbetween.kament.trade.charm_g: Bring a blank. I will cut into it what the mountain lives by.
speech.worldbetween.arki.trade.refuse: No. Your hands have done enough.
speech.worldbetween.arki.trade.empty: The colony is poor just now. Come after a starry night.
speech.worldbetween.arki.trade.greet: We count in amethyst, but take the coin of others too. Secrets are worth most of all.
speech.worldbetween.arki.outlaw: You chose this. Light does not forgive.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.contact: %s and %s have learned of each other. For now it is only wariness: they will fight only if their parties meet.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.rise.2: The feud between %s and %s has flared up: raids and ambushes near the towns have begun.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.rise.3: %s and %s are raising armies: campaigns against small towns begin.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.rise.4: %s and %s are at war to the death.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.cool.1: Things have quieted between %s and %s: only wariness again.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.cool.2: %s and %s have stood down their armies, but the raids go on.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.cool.3: The war of %s and %s has stepped back from the last line.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.defenders: %s of %s led %s fighters out to meet the army of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.sabotage: A raid near %2$s: %1$s burn the stores.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.sabotage_kill: A raid near %2$s: %1$s burn the stores and kill townsfolk.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.sacked: %s has been taken by storm. The victors: %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.razed: %s has been wiped off the map by %s; empty walls are all that is left.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.repelled: %s beat off the assault: the army of %s broke at its walls.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.skirmish: A skirmish %4$s: %1$s got the better of %2$s. %3$s fell.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.seen: %s and %s fought before a stranger's eyes. %s fell.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.ambush.carava: %s took a caravan from %s; the goods are lost, the people dead.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.ambush.settle: %s fell on settlers from %s. The town they went to found will not be.
chronicle.worldbetween.war.ambush_beaten: An ambush by %s on the road from %s failed: the attackers were driven off.
speech.worldbetween.war.neris.patrol: Patrol. Keep away, stranger: this is the border.
speech.worldbetween.war.neris.army: The Kingdom's army on the march. Out of the way.
speech.worldbetween.war.neris.defenders: We meet them in the field, not at the walls.
speech.worldbetween.war.kament.raid: We wait. Stone knows how to wait.
speech.worldbetween.war.kament.army: The mountain is marching. Stand aside.
speech.worldbetween.war.kament.defenders: They will not reach our gates.
speech.worldbetween.war.arki.patrol: We watch from above. We see everyone.
speech.worldbetween.war.arki.army: We lost one sky. We will not give up the second.
speech.worldbetween.war.arki.defenders: We meet them over the water.
command.worldbetween.war.clash: Two patrols stand either side of you.
bossbar.worldbetween.arki.flight: Arki: nobody flies over a colony
message.worldbetween.arki.flight: You are over %s. Nobody flies over the Arki's colonies: come down or go.
message.worldbetween.arki.landed: The Arki no longer watch you.
message.worldbetween.arki.no_building: No building above %s: this is the Arki's sky.
message.worldbetween.arki.broken: You are breaking %s. The Arki saw it.
message.worldbetween.arki.outlaw.flight: You did not come down. To %s you are an enemy now.
message.worldbetween.arki.outlaw.buildin: You kept building above %s. The Arki count you an enemy.
message.worldbetween.arki.outlaw.breakin: You broke %s. The Arki count you an enemy.
chronicle.worldbetween.arki.outlaw: The stranger %s broke the law of the sky over %s and became an enemy of the Arki.
command.worldbetween.works.extras: Manticores: %s · crystal charges: %s · Nether cleared %s%% · eternal night: %s · Morok: %s
chronicle.worldbetween.project.found.man: The scholars of Neris have found how to cross a lion with a great bat. The kingdom needs a menagerie of manticores.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.found.qua: The Kaments' memory has given back the quake crystal: a stone that throws down walls from afar.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.found.com: The Arki astronomers have read the ritual of the comet storm in the stars.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.found.hel: The kingdom speaks of a campaign into the Nether, where the Neris were slaves.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.found.nig: The Arki have learned how to put out the sun: a Tower of Eternal Night.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.found.mor: The Ancients remember the name of Morok, hero of the first war. He can be woken, at the price of souls.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.begun.man: A menagerie of manticores is going up beside the capital.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.begun.qua: Four Kaments gave up their souls: a quake crystal grows from them.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.begun.hel: The barons agreed. The Great Portal of Invasion is going up beside the capital.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.begun.nig: The Arki have begun to grow the Tower of Eternal Night.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.begun.mor: Six Kaments and two soul-sculptors gave themselves to the stone to wake Morok.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.done.mant: The menagerie of manticores at %s is ready. Soon the seekers will take to the sky.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.done.quak: The quake crystal stands before the gates of %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.done.come: The Arki are ready to bring comets down on their enemies.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.done.hell: The Great Portal at %s is lit. The army of Neris has marched into the Nether.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.done.nigh: The Tower of Eternal Night over %s has risen. The sun will not rise again.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.done.moro: The Ancient Morok has woken at %s. He walks the world.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.manticore: A new manticore was bred in the menagerie. %s in all.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.crystal_l: The hold that kept the quake crystal has fallen, and the crystal with it.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.quake_str: The crystal at %s struck: %s shook, its walls are falling.
chronicle.worldbetween.project.storm: The Arki held the ritual: comets are falling on %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.hell.vote_yes: The council of barons approved the campaign into the Nether: %s for, %s against.
chronicle.worldbetween.hell.vote_no: The council of barons refused the king his campaign into the Nether: %s for, %s against.
chronicle.worldbetween.hell.cleared: The purge squads of Neris have cleared %s%% of the Nether.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_4: The kingdom of Neris holds ground in the Nether: the Infernal Campaign has begun.
chronicle.worldbetween.morok.slain: %s struck down the Ancient Morok. In three days he will rise again.
chronicle.worldbetween.morok.gone: %s struck down the Ancient Morok, and the Kaments' capital is gone: Morok will not return.
chronicle.worldbetween.morok.risen: The Ancient Morok has risen from his seat again.
chronicle.worldbetween.morok.journey: Morok fell on travellers from %s. None survived.
message.worldbetween.arki.storm: The sky is alight: the Arki are bringing comets down on this place!
message.worldbetween.kament.crystal: The ground heaves: the Kaments' crystal has struck.
message.worldbetween.hell.squad: A Neris purge squad. You have no writ from the king, so you are a stranger here.
message.worldbetween.hell.squad_writ: A Neris purge squad. You carry the king's writ: they will let you be.
message.worldbetween.hell.writ_given: The king gave you his writ. With it, the kingdom's squads in the Nether will let you be.
message.worldbetween.arki.eternal_night: The sun does not rise. The Arki's eternal night lies over the world.
message.worldbetween.morok.near: The stones around you stir. The Ancient Morok is near.
message.worldbetween.morok.fallen: Morok has crumbled. The Kaments say he will stand again in three days.
message.worldbetween.morok.gone: Morok has crumbled, and the capital that held him is no more. He will not return.
speech.worldbetween.builder.neris: Mending. Walls don't stand up by themselves.
speech.worldbetween.builder.kament: Stone heals slowly. But it heals.
speech.worldbetween.builder.arki: We grow back what they broke.
speech.worldbetween.war.neris.rider: You see everything from up here. And everyone.
speech.worldbetween.hell.squad: What are you doing here? This is the king's ground!
speech.worldbetween.hell.writ: The king's writ? Go on. It's dangerous here.
speech.worldbetween.morok.0: I remember the world before life. I remember your deaths.
speech.worldbetween.morok.1: The stone calls me. I go.
speech.worldbetween.morok.2: While the capital stands, I rise again.
speech.worldbetween.morok.enemy: You are no friend of the mountain. Lie down in it.
speech.worldbetween.war.builder.neris: I'm not here to fight, I'm here to lay the road. Where we've been, a trail stays.
speech.worldbetween.war.builder.kament: Stone under the feet, stone across the water. The mountain's way must hold.
visit.worldbetween.neris.warn.0: Stranger! The guard of %s sends word: the kingdom saw what you did.
visit.worldbetween.neris.warn.1: Don't do it again. This is the first and last kind word.
visit.worldbetween.neris.warn.talk: We only came to talk. For now.
visit.worldbetween.neris.threat.wake: You smell smoke... something is burning!
visit.worldbetween.neris.raze.coming: Horns. The kingdom has come for you from %s.
visit.worldbetween.neris.raze.0: In the king's name and by word of %s: neither you nor your house!
visit.worldbetween.neris.thanks.0: Friend of the kingdom! %s sends you its greetings.
visit.worldbetween.neris.thanks.1: This is for you, from all of us. The barrel's by your door.
visit.worldbetween.kament.warn.0: Outsider. The hold of %s heard you knocking where you shouldn't.
visit.worldbetween.kament.warn.1: The mountain is patient, but not endlessly. Don't do it again.
visit.worldbetween.kament.threat.wake: Dark and close. Stone all around.
visit.worldbetween.kament.raze.coming: The ground hums under heavy feet. The mountain comes from %s.
visit.worldbetween.kament.raze.0: The hold of %s has passed judgement. Not a stone shall stand.
visit.worldbetween.kament.thanks.0: Friend of the mountain. The hold of %s remembers your hands.
visit.worldbetween.kament.thanks.1: We bring what the mountain gives only to its own. The chest is beside you.
visit.worldbetween.arki.warn.0: Stranger. The colony of %s saw you from the stars.
visit.worldbetween.arki.warn.1: The law is one for all under the sky. Do not break it again.
visit.worldbetween.arki.threat.wake: A crash and a ringing! Something came down through the roof!
visit.worldbetween.arki.raze.coming: The sky glows. The Arki are gathering from %s.
visit.worldbetween.arki.raze.0: The colony of %s has cast you out. The sky will no longer shelter your house.
visit.worldbetween.arki.thanks.0: The stars favour you. The colony of %s sends its light.
visit.worldbetween.arki.thanks.1: Take it, the chest is beside you. May your sky be clear.
visit.worldbetween.arki.thanks.talk: You are a friend of the sky.
visit.worldbetween.raze.beaten: The war party is broken. But they will be back.
speech.worldbetween.patrol.neris: We walk the round of %s, day and night. No one gets past us.
speech.worldbetween.patrol.kament: The mountain keeps watch round %s. Stone does not sleep.
speech.worldbetween.patrol.arki: We fly the round of the colony. The sky above it is ours.
